A [[human]] served as a '''soldier''' in the [[Resistance]] during its [[First Order-Resistance War|conflict]] with the [[First Order]]. The [[Resistance trooper|soldier]] participated in the [[Battle of Crait]], and was one of the troops who manned the [[Crait outpost|abandoned outpost's]] trenches in preparation for the First Order's assault, during which they lined up next to [[Sharp (Resistance)|Sergeant Sharp]].<ref name="Episode VIII" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This character was portrayed by [[Gareth Edwards]],<ref name="Episode VIII" /> the director of the [[2016]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''..<ref name="Rogue One">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> His role was confirmed in the movie's credits where he was listed as "Resistance Trench Soldier".<ref name="Episode VIII" />
